messages:
oliver.sales: Quick sync 1 BlueBank POC starts Monday. Security only allows two fixed outbound IPs from our side for egress. Need a minimal plan, timeline, and any extra charges we should flag.

priya.solutions: Short plan: provision a Dedicated pool with a NAT gateway exposing 2 static egress IPs, scoped POC API key, and an expiry window. We'll hand them the IPs for firewall allowlisting.

han.eng: Implementation notes: we can attach a NAT with 2 static IPs to a Dedicated pool. Provisioning depends on infra queue: staging same-day, production-grade NAT + certs typically 24-48h. If they want zonal redundancy (IPs in different AZs) add ~12h.

megan.sre: Rotation question: we do not rotate static IPs automatically during a POC. If they insist on rotation we can schedule a coordinated switchover, but they must update their FW or support a CIDR. Also add a traffic estimate so we size the pool.

oliver.sales: They also asked for mTLS to the endpoint and logs of source IPs. Can we do both?

priya.solutions: mTLS is available on Private by default. For Dedicated we can enable client cert validation at the edge as an enterprise option; POC enablement ~48h and they must supply certs. Access logs with source IP are standard; we can share a short sample CSV export or short-lived log stream.

han.eng: For quick validation give them two checks they can run from their bastion: 1) confirm egress IP 2) hit a health endpoint with the POC key. Example we hand them: 

```
# check egress IP
curl -s https://ifconfig.me

# basic endpoint test (POC_KEY issued by us)
curl -X POST https://dedicated-api.rw.example/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"healthcheck\"}'
```

megan.sre: Ops checklist for ticket: 1) reserve 2 static egress IPs 2) create Dedicated pool + NAT 3) issue scoped POC API key with rate limits 4) enable TLS (mTLS if requested) 5) set log export and retention for POC 6) notify customer with IPs, curl tests, expiry.

oliver.sales: Fees? sales-ops needs numbers to discuss. Can we waive setup fee for POC?

priya.solutions: Standard: one-time setup fee + monthly IP surcharge. For strategic trials sales-ops can waive setup fee; looping in @alex for approval.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-2178 created for BlueBank POC provisioning (owner: han.eng). ETA: 2026-08-14.

oliver.sales: Nice. I'll add expected RPS and token budget to INF-2178 and ask BlueBank to provide any client certs if they want mTLS. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
